projects.title: ML-based weather forecasting
projects.excerpt: Weather predictor that ingests historical data to forecast short-term conditions with a reproducible pipeline.

details.heading: Highlights
items: Automated data cleaning, feature engineering, and train/validate splits.
Model training with cross-validation and metrics reporting.
Configurable forecasting horizons and evaluation windows.
Lightweight CLI/notebook workflows for quick iteration.
details.outcome: Actionable short-term forecasts with transparent metrics and a maintainable pipeline.

projects.title: Face comparison application
projects.excerpt: Detects and compares faces in images to estimate similarity and flag likely matches.

details.heading: Highlights
items: Drag-and-drop image ingestion with validation.
Face detection pipeline using Haar cascades.
Visual overlays communicating match confidence.
Modular architecture for alternative models.
details.outcome: Practical tool to quickly verify whether two images likely depict the same person.

projects.title: CommerceHub - AI Inventory Management
projects.excerpt: AI-powered inventory assistant for e-commerce that uses ARIMA forecasting to predict stockouts, optimize reorder timing, and generate intelligent recommendations for inventory management.

details.heading: Highlights
items: ARIMA-based demand forecasting with exponential smoothing fallback for robust predictions across varying data quality.
Intelligent recommendation engine with 7 types of insights (critical stockouts, trending products, slow movers, seasonal patterns, overstock alerts, price optimization, stock balancing).
Adaptive learning system that remembers dismissed recommendations and generates alternative strategies to match business preferences.
Seamless Shopify integration with one-click sync, real-time updates, and direct admin portal links.(unable to use webhooks on localhost)
Feature engineering pipeline with anomaly detection, velocity tracking, and seasonal signal analysis for accurate forecasts.
Full-stack implementation with FastAPI backend, React+Vite frontend, and SQLAlchemy ORM for data persistence.
details.outcome: Worked on backend API development, ETL pipeline for data processing, ARIMA model
